About this item

  • Engine Type: 52cc 2-stroke petrol engine, ideal for brush cutters and garden tools.
  • Power Output: 2.5HP for high-performance strimming and cutting.
  • Speed: Operates at 8000 RPM for efficient cutting and harvesting.
  • Power Source: Petrol-operated for increased portability; no need for a power outlet.
  • Weight: Lightweight at 4.5 kilograms, ensuring easy handling and installation.
  • Applications: Suitable for crop harvesting, garden strimming, and landscaping tasks.
